about_the_game:
ToneTrek is a colorful and clever logic puzzle game where every step reshapes the board.
Your mission: walk across a grid of tiles, change their colors in a looping sequence, and recreate a target pattern — all in as few moves as possible.

With minimalist visuals, relaxing sound design, and gameplay that ranges from chill to brain-bending, ToneTrek is perfect for puzzle fans who enjoy planning, experimenting, and finding the most efficient path.

Whether you're playing a quick level or diving into the full campaign, every puzzle is handcrafted to challenge your logic and creativity.

🎮 Features

  • 🧠 Grid-Based Logic Gameplay – Each step cycles a tile’s color; plan your route carefully to match the goal.

  • 🎯 Multiple Game Modes – Campaign, single-level, move limit, time limit, and free play options.

  • 🎨 Customizable Visuals – Choose from a variety of color palettes and tile styles to suit your mood.

  • 📈 Score Attack – Beat your own move/time records and unlock harder challenges.

  • 🌍 Multilingual Support – English, Español, Deutsch, and Magyar at launch.

  • 🧩 100 Handcrafted Levels – From simple geometric patterns to complex pixel-art shapes.

  • 🔄 Replay-Friendly Design – Try different strategies, improve your path, or just relax and color your way through.

  • 🆘 Built-In Tutorial – Learn the rules step by step with accessible onboarding.

ToneTrek is simple to pick up but offers deep satisfaction for players who enjoy puzzles that reward clever thinking and precision planning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD FX Series
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible
